name: Crystal Palace Park Dinosaur Playground
description: Dinosaur-themed playground that opened in March 2026, with a dinosaur skeleton climbing frame, giant dinosaur egg play features, basket swings and a footprint-shaped sandpit. Accessible features include a wheelchair-accessible roundabout, an accessible slide and swing, and adjustable-height games. There's a Changing Places toilet nearby in the park. GiGL also lists a water play area in the park.
